title: Two questions about the user interface
author: vndnua
body_snippet: 1. When I move (using the mouse or keyboard) an existing connection in the tree, nothing visually happens. The element is actually being moved; it’s just that the tree isn’t being redrawn. If I create a new connection or delete an existing one, the connection tree is updated immediately and the changes are visible. 2. comments.author: robertpopa22
comments.snippet:
Thanks both — these are two independent things, so let me split them.

**1. Tree not redrawing when you move a connection in place — fixed.**
Reordering a connection inside its current folder (mouse drag or keyboard) was updating the data but not repainting the tree, so nothing appeared to move; add/delete worked because they take a different refresh path. Root cause was a missing `Move` case in the tree's collection-changed handler. Fixed in commit `f65cf65d2` — in-place reorders now redraw imm...

comments.snippet:
Thanks for the detail, @DrSchnagels — that narrows part 2 nicely.

**Part 1 (tree not redrawing on an in-place move)** — the fix is already in (`f65cf65d2`) and lands in the next nightly, so a quick retest there would confirm it's sorted on your side.

**Part 2 (File Menu + External Tools Bar won't stay side-by-side on one row)** — your answers rule out the size angle: it's purely the *row placement* not being restored. Lock Toolbars only controls the grips, not which row a bar lands on at start...
